rationale: The original short thesis relied on a sharp volume rejection at VWAP ($15.47) and a breakdown below the 5-minute 9-EMA to trigger immediate continuation through the session low ($15.38). However, after 25 minutes, selling follow-through has failed to materialize, and price has instead steadily ground higher on low volume to reclaim the 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.42). With the momentum catalyst exhausted and price reclaimed above short-term resistance at $15.44, exiting now cuts the loss early before a full retest of the $15.48 invalidation level.
